releaseNotes: Staged updates now install IMMEDIATELY after Excel exits. The previous beta could take seconds - or wait forever if an unrelated Excel process was running anywhere on the machine. The updater now tracks the exact Excel process that requested the update, polls its exit every 500 ms, and starts installing the moment it closes. Excel processes in other Windows sessions never delay the install.

The Updates window now shows every state plainly: update ready, waiting for Excel to close (with the Excel process IDs), installing, and installed. The primary action is 'Install When Excel Closes' - Elmashad never restarts or force-closes Excel; you save your work and close it normally, and the update takes over the moment Excel is gone.
If Excel closes visually but an Excel process stays in the background, Elmashad tells you which process is still running and lets you Wait or Cancel - it never kills anything.
Staged-update state and job files are now written atomically, so an interrupted save can never corrupt the pending update. Duplicate updater instances are prevented at launch.
Measured on a real Excel instance in the sandbox: Excel exit to detection 83 ms, detection to SHA verification 37 ms, verification to install start 1 ms.
All release gates re-run: the exact built installer was executed on a fresh machine against an offline update endpoint, and the published bytes were re-downloaded and executed after publishing.
